recipe.description: Original Syndicate Enforcer face: broad temple and mandibular body, restrained square taper, wider chin with moderate projection, broad straight nose and quiet eyelids. The enlarged neck is fitted to substantial human shoulders beneath the original protective vest. Graphical source parameter names establish no ethnicity, gender, age or story. Exact seeded complexion and chestnut tied rear bun are preserved.

source_indices: All source vertex/UV/face/triangle indices are zero based. Face IDs count every OBJ f line. Triangle IDs count every original face fan triangle, including discarded body regions and helper groups.
